Remarks

Implemented by a provider package. A caller depends on this and registers the provider in its composition root, so which provider takes the money is a deployment decision rather than a reference in its business code.

CreatePaymentMethodIntentAsync(string, CancellationToken)

An attempt at saving a payment method for later, off-session use, for a caller that hosts its own form.

public Task<IResult<PaymentMethodIntentDTO>> CreatePaymentMethodIntentAsync(string customerId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Parameters

customerId string

Whose payment method is being saved.

cancellationToken CancellationToken

Cancels the call.

Returns

Task<IResult<PaymentMethodIntentDTO>>

Remarks

Hosting the form means the card and the provider's script reach the caller's own origin, which is a PCI surface and a content security policy exception. CreateHostedPaymentMethodPageAsync(HostedPaymentMethodPageRequest, CancellationToken) is the alternative that avoids both.
